title: Student Council & Class of 2027
role: Student Council President · August 2026 – now · Separate website project
description: As Student Council President, I plan events, lead event committees, and help staff. Separately, I designed, built, and maintain the Class of 2027 website.

title: National Independent Black Student Union
description: As president, I help plan and run kickoffs and social events, including bowling and restaurant gatherings. A state representative and a senator have also attended our events.

title: Juneteenth Lake County
description: I directed volunteers where they were needed and helped keep operations coordinated. I also helped vendors settle in, assisted them, and checked that they had what they needed to operate.

title: AVNT
description: I founded AVNT, a project management, marketing, and hiring agency for Roblox project teams. I work with my leadership team on client projects, and I designed its identity and developed its website, operations dashboard, and supporting bot tools.

title: Playverse
role: Project manager · AVNT client · September 2023 – now
description: Playverse develops and publishes games on Roblox. I joined its team in September 2023, and the studio later became an AVNT client. I work with its team on project coordination, brand and social channels, and partnerships, about twelve hours per week. My social-media work included growing the studio’s X account to 130,000 followers.

title: Project management for Roblox teams
description: Project manager on a series of Roblox games and developer tools, from RoTube Life in 2022 to Ropilot.ai and Wilbo.ai in 2026. Across them my part was hiring and staffing, partnerships, product decisions with the founders, marketing and community, launch and live operations, testing, and day-to-day team leadership. Results on those projects belong to their teams.

title: Hearth
role: App design and development · Early 2026 – now
description: A private web app for messaging, files, notes, and personal tools for a small circle, with an iOS wrapper, built under the working name Royal Vault. My work spans the interface, server, real-time messaging, file handling, and the iOS wrapper.
